kpis.citation: One, the revenue through the first half of the year is about $45 million associated with the 45Q, not the number that you suggested.
I don't think a lot of physical tons moved at that level, we since corrected back up to the $400-$415 level where we are today.
Today they're running at about, we target them at an 82%-83% operating rate, where we run at 98%-99%.
Where they will be longer term, I think that where they are today in that 4-6 million tons probably for this year and the next, and will be determined later in the future.
